Weekend Coffee Chat

Two coworkers, Linh and An, are having a casual coffee chat on a Friday afternoon, discussing what they plan to do over the weekend.

1:04 · 7 key terms ↓

Dialogue

· curious

Hey Alex, good to see you. What are you up to this weekend?

Alex
· relaxed
